claim: 工作点3（企业级私有云专线）的盈亏平衡日均上传量 Break_Even_Daily_Upload = (F_line_10G / 30) / Price_PayPerUse_GB，若 F_line_10G = ¥50,000 且公有云上传单价 Price_PayPerUse_GB = ¥0.1/GB，则 Break_Even ≈ 50,000 / 30 / 0.1 ≈ 16,667 GB/天 ≈ 16.3 TB/天
